newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Vision sees medium term revenue growth.
newsitem.headline: Vision sees medium term revenue growth.

text.p: Australian electronics group Vision Systems Ltd said on Wednesday it was confident of maintaining its historic revenue growth in the medium and long term, after delays with key product releases which have seen the company warn of lower earnings expected for 1996/97.

Executive director Chris Abell, opening a A$2.7 million extension to Vision's Adelaide design and manufacturing centre, said the company had experienced dramatic growth since 1993 with revenues up nine-fold to A$90 million in 1995/96 and exports jumping to A$60 million from A$3 million.
"The expanded Adelaide facility will enable us to continue this growth, with a major increase in sales as new products and services come to market," he said.
"We are confident of maintaining our historic revenue growth in the medium and long term," he said.
Vision's managing director Jim Fox last year said forecasts for a drop in net profit before abnormals in 1996/97 to about A$7 million from A$10.6 million were close to the mark.
